literal: Those who retaliated, as a thing of value they will not esteem indeed; they will esteem those who endured, like gold having treasured.
translation: The wise will not consider those who retaliate as having any worth. But they will treasure those who endure wrongs, keeping them safe like gold.
modern: தீங்கு செய்தவரைத் தண்டிப்பவர்களைச் சான்றோர் ஒரு பொருட்டாக மதிக்க மாட்டார்கள். ஆனால், பொறுத்துக்கொள்பவர்களைப் பொன்னைப்போலப் போற்றித் தம் மனத்துள் வைத்துக்கொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the vengeful with the forgiving. The word 'ஒன்றாக' literally means 'as one', but here takes the sense of 'as a thing of value' or 'as something that matters'. The wise do not give any regard to those who retaliate against wrongs. However, they highly esteem those who practice forbearance, holding them in their minds just as one would carefully wrap and protect precious gold.
